import subprocess,re
S={};n=None
for l in open('/app/sequences.fasta'):
    l=l.strip()
    if l.startswith('>'): n=l[1:];S[n]=''
    elif l: S[n]+=l.upper()
rc=lambda s:s[::-1].translate(str.maketrans('ACGT','TGCA'))
def tm(s):
    return float(subprocess.check_output(['/tmp/p3src/primer3-2.6.1/src/oligotm','-tp','1','-sc','1','-mv','50','-dv','2','-n','0.8','-d','500',s]))
for k,v in S.items(): print(k,len(v),'BsaI sites',len(re.findall('GGTCTC|GAGACC',v)))
inp=S['input']
# anchors
i_fwd=inp.index('TGAGGATCCCGGG'); i_rev_end=inp.index('ACATATGATCAG')+6  # end after ...ACATAT
print(i_fwd,i_rev_end)
PAD='TTGCAT';SITE='GGTCTC'
def fwd_cands(t,start):
    return [t[start:start+L] for L in range(15,46)]
def rev_cands(t,end):
    return [rc(t[end-L:end]) for L in range(15,46)]
spec={ # name: (template, fwd start, rev end, rev tail overhang rc)
 'input':(inp,i_fwd,i_rev_end,'TCAT'),
 'egfp':(S['egfp'],0,len(S['egfp'])-3,'TACC'),
 'flag':(S['flag'],3,S['flag'].index('GGTTCATAA')+6,'TGTC'),
 'snap':(S['snap'],3,len(S['snap']),'CTCA'),
}
# egfp end: remove TAA
for name,(t,fs,re_,tail) in spec.items():
    F=fwd_cands(t,fs);R=rev_cands(t,re_)
    best=None
    for a in F:
        for b in R:
            ta,tb=tm(a),tm(b)
            if 58<=ta<=72 and 58<=tb<=72 and abs(ta-tb)<=5:
                sc=abs(ta-62)+abs(tb-62)+abs(ta-tb)
                if best is None or sc<best[0]: best=(sc,a,b,ta,tb)
    _,a,b,ta,tb=best
    print(name,a,round(ta,2),b,round(tb,2))
    spec[name]=(a,b,tail)
out=''
for name,(a,b,tail) in spec.items():
    f=PAD+SITE+'A'+a if name!='x' else ''
    r=PAD+SITE+'A'+tail+b
    out+=f'>{name}_fwd\n{f}\n>{name}_rev\n{r}\n'
open('/app/primers.fasta','w').write(out)
print(out)
EOF

    if l.startswith('>'): n=l[1:]
    else: P[n]=l.upper()
rc=lambda s:s[::-1].translate(str.maketrans('ACGT','TGCA'))
def pcr(name,circ=False):
    t=S[name]; f=P[name+'_fwd']; r=P[name+'_rev']
    fa=f[f.index('GGTCTC')+7:]  # after N
    # find 3' annealing: longest suffix of primer that matches
    def anneal(p,t):
        for L in range(len(p),10,-1):
            if p[-L:] in t: return L
    Lf=anneal(f,t); Lr=anneal(r,rc(t) if False else t+t if False else t) 
    return None
def prod(name):
    t=S[name]; tt=t+t if name=='input' else t
    f=P[name+'_fwd']; r=P[name+'_rev']
    def ann(p,tt):
        for L in range(len(p),10,-1):
            if p[-L:] in tt or False: return L
    Lf=0
    for L in range(len(f),10,-1):
        if f[-L:] in tt: Lf=L;break
    rr=rc(r); Lr=0
    for L in range(len(rr),10,-1):
        if rr[:L] in tt: Lr=L;break
    # 5' tails
    ftail=f[:len(f)-Lf]; rtail=rc(r[:len(r)-Lr])
    s=tt.index(f[-Lf:]); 
    e=tt.index(rr[:Lr],s)+Lr
    return ftail+tt[s:e]+rtail
